title: Picking a rep turned off in another tab is refused with a message
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active staff member for this test at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have an open, uninvoiced work order for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field reading "Unassigned".
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • Open sales rep B's staff record in a second tab of the same browser, with the "Sales Representative" switch on.
custom_steps:
1. In the first tab, click the Sales Representative field so the dropdown lists sales rep B.
  2. In the second tab, turn the "Sales Representative" switch off.
  3. In the second tab, save the staff record.
  4. Back in the first tab, without reloading, click sales rep B in the open dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The dropdown is open and lists sales rep B.

Step 2:

  • The switch shows off.

Step 3:

  • The staff record saves.

Step 4:

  • The change is refused with the message "The selected staff member is not a sales representative."
  • The field returns to "Unassigned".

A stale open dropdown is the way a manual tester can send a person who is no longer a sales representative. If the build re-checks the list when the dropdown is clicked and never offers the person, mark the case Blocked and say so.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative)

  • S1-N3: “If a change cannot be saved, the field returns to the last saved value and an error message shows.”
